policy_en: A freeze is pre-print only if the GitHub commit time is before the official release. CPI 11 Sep and NFP 4 Sep freezes were internal; first public copy is the 14 Sep 10:20 snapshot (commit c32856a). This same snapshot is a public pre-print freeze for FOMC 15–16 Sep. Later prints get their own history file before release.
policy_zh: 只有 GitHub commit 时间早于官方公布，冻盘才算事前。CPI 9/11 和非农 9/4 的冻结当时只在内部；第一次公开是 9/14 10:20 快照（commit c32856a）。同一份快照可作为 9/15–16 FOMC 的事前公开冻结。之后的公布会在发布前单独追加历史文件。

snapshots.note_en: First public snapshot. CPI/NFP freezes inside were internal before this commit.
snapshots.note_zh: 第一次公开快照。其中 CPI/非农冻结在此 commit 之前只在内部。

snapshots.note_en: Adds watch list, status fields, and pre-print labeling. Same 10:20 scan.
snapshots.note_zh: 补观察名单、状态字段和事前标记。扫描仍是 10:20。
